releases.name: 0.1.0-beta.2
releases.body:
## 0.1.0-beta.2

First recommended public beta of the Projects Sidebar for OpenCode Desktop.
Supersedes 0.1.0-beta.1, which pulled an unnecessary runtime dependency.

- Project-grouped chats with nested forks
- In Progress / Unread activity panel
- Native rename, fork, close, and delete actions
- Project drafts, collapsed groups, and persistent sidebar width
- Automatic fallback to the standard Inbox

Install: add `opencode-desktop-projects-sidebar@beta` to `plugins` in the global `opencode.jsonc`.

Requires OpenCode Desktop 2.2.5–2.2.7.
